Third-party notices for the Orket companion extension template
===========================================================

These components retain their original licenses. Orket original code is Apache-2.0.
This inventory conservatively includes the locked frontend production dependencies
and Vite (whose module-preload helper may appear in the browser bundle). Some
listed packages supply build-time types or helpers removed by bundling.
Only the Vite core MIT helper license is included; the Vite Node build tool
and its bundled dependencies are not redistributed in the browser output.
The original JavaScript license comments and font bytes are preserved.
